context: Asuka lectures on ethics and choice, with literary speculation.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: philosophy lecture; literary forms (あろう/つつ/のみ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 正しさとは、誰が決めるのであろうか。
lines.style: contemplative teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 社会が、決めるのではないでしょうか。
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会は変わりつつ、答えも変わります。
lines.en: As society changes, the answer changes too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 法のみでは、人を導けません。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: では、その他に何が要るんでしょう。
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良心であろうと、私は考えます。
lines.style: reflective teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 全ての行いに、責任が伴います。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 迷いつつ、考え続けるしかないんですね。
lines.en: We can only keep thinking while we doubt.
lines.style: moved young student voice, soft warm quiet realization throughout
